dialogue_texts: Festivals are supposed to be a time for having fun. I don't know what's causing the fairies to act up...
The Scarlet Devil is mad now...
Koakuma!? What have you come to Kozankyo for!? You and other Order members were not invited.
Having learned that you've taken out the Grieg twins, I think it's time for more revenge.
I don't have time for this - leave the fairies alone and let me enjoy the festival!
With my revenge ready, the festival will be cut short...
